about.title: Who We Are
about.subtitle: The philanthropic arm of Hancock Prospecting, guided by values of excellence, transparency, and social impact.
about.history_text: Founded with a firm commitment to return a share of the success from the Hancock group's industrial and exploration activities to society, the Fundación Prospección Hancock has become a global pillar for community development. Under the visionary leadership of Gina Rinehart — a pioneer of the Australian iron ore industry and founder of some of the largest mining projects in the world — the foundation funds hundreds of schools, health clinics, and natural conservation programs worldwide. Since 1992, when Gina Rinehart became Executive Chairman of Hancock Prospecting, the company transformed from a troubled organization into one of the most successful private companies in Australian history.
about.mission_text: To support initiatives that empower marginalized communities, promote high-quality education and medical excellence, and drive ecological conservation.
about.vision_text: To be a global force for positive change, recognized for integrity, efficient resource management, and long-term project sustainability.

values.integrity_desc: We act with absolute transparency and ethical accountability in every donation and partnership.
values.excellence_desc: We pursue the highest standards of quality and technical rigor in the execution of all projects.
values.impact_desc: We design long-lasting solutions that foster self-reliance and long-term progress.
